text.title: JPA / Hibernate Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the JPA-layer manifest this methodology produces. Validator enforces required keys + per-field constraints. `narrow_repository` and `service` are OPTIONAL blocks — omit them for a fetch/migration audit, supply them when the artefact is a full entity + repository + service spec, in which case every constraint inside them is enforced.

section.title: Schema

example.code: { "spring_boot_version": "2.7.0", "ddl_auto": "update", "open_in_view": true, "entities": [{ "class": "com.acme.billing.invoice", "business_key": "", "associations_lazy": false, "uses_lombok_data": true, "has_audit_timestamps": false, "associations": [{"kind": "OneToMany", "cascade": "ALL", "fetch": "EAGER", "justification": ""}] }], "narrow_repository": {"interface_name": "InvoiceRepo", "extends_jparepository_directly": true}, "service": {"class_name": "invoiceSvc", "uses_dto_projection_on_reads": false, "uses_joinfetch_or_entitygraph": false}, "migrations_paired": false, "fetch_audit": {"eager_associations_found": ["Invoice.lines"]}, "forbidden_patterns_found": ["CascadeType.ALL on @ManyToOne in Invoice.customer"] }
example.note: Spring Boot 2.x; ddl-auto auto-mutates; OSIV on; no business key; no audit timestamps; @Data on entity; eager fetch + cascade ALL without justification; raw JpaRepository exposed to the service; no DTO projection; migrations missing.

list.item: Entity diff without a paired Flyway migration.

antipattern.reason: Violates `datajpatest-for-repositories` (OSIV off in all profiles) and reopens the lazy-outside-transaction failure mode.

antipattern.description: Any entry in `entities[].associations` with an empty or under-10-character `justification`.
